svg.text: 4. A revoked permit blocks the other
The HDAB only grants data permits, as credentials from its own issuer; Lux Biobank checks them at negotiation and at each transfer. Every DSP request carries a DCP token; Lux Biobank asks
Schuman's identity for the credentials the offer needs and reads the issuers' status lists. The STS calls and the catalog request are left out.
the HDAB registers Schuman with permitId P-2026-001,
5. GET data address, with the token
the offer for P-2026-002 is refused: no such permit
the HDAB deletes Schuman's registration and makes it
again with P-2026-002: one set of claims per participant
agreement FINALIZED; the P-2026-001 agreement still transfers
the HDAB revokes P-2026-001: its status list bit is set
TERMINATED: the whole presentation is refused (TD-20); no reason given
Schuman deletes the revoked permit from its identity;
Digital Lux Trust revokes the HDAB's own
11. negotiate the offer for access bodies
agreement FINALIZED: the HDAB's issuer is trusted for every type
